featured_reviews.name: Samruddhi Parab
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently had a disappointing experience getting a haircut. I had clearly specified the length I wanted, but the stylist ended up cutting my hair much shorter than I approved. Before the cut, I mentioned that my hair tends to be frizzy and asked if any particular haircut would suit me. They assured me it would be fine. However, after the cut, they bluntly told me that the haircut didn't look good and that I should take better care of my hair.

The entire experience felt unprofessional and driven by greed, as they seemed more interested in getting my money than providing quality service.

Don't want to given even one star

featured_reviews.name: Tulsi Paleja
featured_reviews.review_text: I had a disappointing experience with my recent haircut.  The previous stylist did a wonderful job, but this time, despite showing a picture of the style I wanted, the result was unsatisfactory. The layers are uneven and shapeless, look like a child's fringe cut.

featured_reviews.name: Shreya Gupta
featured_reviews.review_text:
Horrible horrible experience. I went for simple layers and even showed them the photo reference i wanted. First the main guy i wanted my hair to be cut from, handed me to someone else. And he went ahead and absolutely butchered up my hair. The layers looks like a badly done chopped bob cut and my bangs are above my eyebrows. It looks like those covid bangs gone wrong. Do not go to such unprofessional people if u don't wanna end up with flimsy accuse of "they'll grow out in 15 days" and a bad haircut to hide for another 15.

Wish to not even give them 1 star.

featured_reviews.name: Raj Khair
featured_reviews.review_text: I recently visited Tilism Salon and had an extremely disappointing experience. I asked for a simple trim, but the stylist seemed to completely misunderstand my request. Not only did they cut off way more than I asked for, but the end result was uneven and choppy. It looks like they used dull scissors or just didn't care about precision. To make matters worse, the stylist was dismissive when I pointed out the issues. Now I have to deal with this bad haircut until it grows out. I would not recommend Tilism Salon to anyone looking for a quality haircut.
